claims.statement: On bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain (input T=[x]P0, x uniform in [0,r), no auxiliary powers), the algorithm in this package recovers and verifies x by [x]G=T with measured probability 0.2825 at the exact ledger budget (one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.2694; 0.26854 after the cap-loss CP-95 upper bound 0.003179), measured on the shipped escape-armed walk at 715,000,012 classes, 16 walkers, 1,687 steps per walker and 3,200 trials, visits/sqrt(N)=1.009444 against the ledger shape 1.0096963, using at most 2^126.266 native-equivalent work units at C=2000. Evidence: the matched no-escape control on identical starts succeeds 0.0050 and is absorbed in a 2-cycle in all 3,200 trials, while the shipped lag-1 escape is never absorbed in a 2-cycle and leaves 2,872 of 3,200 trials in a 3-cycle, so a lag-2/lag-3 trigger was implemented (substituting from the post-step state and re-evaluating the DP gate) and measured: 0 of 3,200 in 3-cycles and success 0.28313, +0.000625 over lag-1, with all 3,200 per-pair prefix traces byte-identical up to the branch step. Cap loss is measured on the would-solve denominator: 0 of 941 lost at the 1,687-step cap with CP-95 upper 0.003179, and 0.65569 / 0.90648 at caps 843 / 421, with the meeting-step censoring stated. The production model 1-exp(-S(S-1)(w-1)/(2Nw)) = 0.3995 propagated through the measured coalescence ratio 0.774365 and detection 0.96706 gives 0.2992 point and 0.26587 at the CP-95 coalescence bound, i.e. below the 0.39 floor, and is reported as below rather than asserted. Absorption on the repaired predecessor-dependent process is measured at two sizes (16,384 starts each, P(absorbed)=1.0, period_2=0, three-cycle share 0.0263 -> 0.0007) with a re-pin mutation control that moves the mass by 0.7810; the restart price is regenerated by script (476.644 ref per scalar action, 1,485.1600 ref per fresh start) and consumed by ledger.py; scripts/selfaudit.py enforces every cited path and field and catches a planted wrong path.

title: Plain G1 v20p: per-lane cycle-channel census (control 3200/3200 in 2-cycles, lag-1 residual 2872/3200 in 3-cycles), lag-3 escape removes the 3-cycle channel, cap-loss conditional 0/941 CP 0.003179, propagated 0.26587 - 126.266
